newsitem.title: USA: CHANDLER SEES CONTINUING LITIGATION COSTS.
newsitem.headline: CHANDLER SEES CONTINUING LITIGATION COSTS.

text.p: Chandler Insurance said Tuesday it will continue to incur costs relating to lawsuits involving the CenTra Group.

The company said in statement that CenTra continues to appeal a ruling to divest itself of 3,131,825 Chandler shares to the U.S. Court of Appeals in the 8th circuit. Chandler said that a stay of the order has not been granted.

The insurance company said the shares subject to the divestiture order represent approximately 45% of the Company's outstanding stock (excludes stock rescission judgment and stock held by subsidiary).

The Company said previously the verdicts handed down by the Oklahoma U.S. District Court on April 22 found in favor of CenTra and an affiliate, an award totaling $11,981,633 against Chandler Insurance and an affiliate Chandler Insurance (Barbados) Ltd.

Under the judgments, Chandler said CenTra must return to it certain stock. The Company will continue to incur related litigation costs pending final resolution of these matters and other CenTra related transactions. Tuesday, 29 July 1997 14:12:47 ENDS nN29263751
